integrity: Analytic Weyl-character calculation and periodic logarithmic lemma supply the infinite-dimensional proof; the included standard-library Python checker independently corroborates finite identities and asymptotic slopes.
scientific_limitations: Fixed arithmetic modulus and residue; no claim for general sparse subsets, growing modulus, intermediate Lp norms or other Lie groups. Older spectral-sampling terminology may hide an earlier equivalence. Finite numerical tests are corroborative, not proof.
title: Logarithmic endpoint amplification from arithmetic Peter–Weyl thinning on \(SU(2)\)
